label: 3. This letter can be traced all the way back to …

lines.speaker: cocoa
lines.text:
This letter can be traced all the way back to the surface. It goes around and around every year, delivering fortune and prosperity to everyone who receives it.
After getting this letter, you have 7 days to send it to someone else.

lines.speaker: cocoa
lines.text: You must send the letter to 7 people who could use a bit of luck in their lives.

lines.speaker: cocoa
lines.text:
Disseminate this letter and you have 7 years of good fortune.
If you don't, you will be down on your luck for 3 years.

lines.speaker: cocoa
lines.text: This letter cannot be ignored, so don't forget: 7 letters to 7 lucky recipients.

lines.speaker: cocoa
lines.text: You may think it's a bit inconvenient, but look on the bright side: There's 7 years of good luck waiting at the end of all this!

lines.speaker: cocoa
lines.text: I was told that this is a lucky letter.
Something tells me that isn't exactly true.

lines.speaker: cocoa
lines.text: I'm starting to feel the same way.

lines.speaker: cocoa
lines.text: I heard that someone earned 2 billion credits

lines.speaker: cocoa
lines.text: after sending this letter out.
Have you already sent it to 7 people?

lines.speaker: cocoa
lines.text: Yes. You're the last one.
Who else did you send it to?

lines.speaker: cocoa
lines.text: Ade, Soda,

lines.speaker: cocoa
lines.text: and some customers of the Maid Cafe.
You sent it to the customers?

lines.speaker: cocoa
lines.text: I want fortune

lines.speaker: cocoa
lines.text: to smile upon everyone.

lines.speaker: cocoa
lines.text: You should start sending this letter out straight away, Master.
I don't know who else I can send it to.

lines.speaker: cocoa
lines.text: You're kidding.

lines.speaker: cocoa
lines.text: You don't have even one other person in mind?
Nope. I'm about to get slammed with bad luck.
Cocoa doesn't respond for a while.

lines.speaker: cocoa
lines.text: Master,

lines.speaker: cocoa
lines.text: come to the Maid Cafe. Quick!

lines.speaker: cocoa
lines.text: I asked some of the customers if they'd mind being sent the lucky letter,

lines.speaker: cocoa
lines.text: and they said they'd be happy to receive it.

lines.speaker: cocoa
lines.text: So you can just send the letter to them.
It's not really that impor...

lines.speaker: cocoa
lines.text: Master,

lines.speaker: cocoa
lines.text: you could be facing 3 years of bad luck here!

lines.speaker: cocoa
lines.text: Sorry, but I've got to go. Ade is calling me.

lines.speaker: cocoa
lines.text: Remember to send the letter over Blabla when you arrive at the Maid Cafe!
